question.text: Why is the TRUST structure the most common choice for domestic AIFs in India? Pick the best reason.

answer.text: Trusts are the only legal form permitted by SEBI for AIFs
Trusts have the shortest mandatory life (1 year) compared to LLPs (5 years) and Companies (10 years)
Trusts are exempt from SEBI registration requirements
Trusts offer operational flexibility, bespoke governance terms between Manager and beneficiaries, lower compliance cost and favourable tax treatment

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook links trust preference to operational advantages, lower compliance cost, governance and reporting flexibility, bespoke investment arrangements between the Manager and beneficiaries, and favourable tax treatment under the determinate-trust regime. The Trap: Option A is false because LLPs, Companies and Body Corporates are all permitted vehicles. Option B fabricates mandatory-life numbers for trusts, LLPs and companies. Option C is false; trusts must still register under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations. Option D is the supported reason. Note: Source pages 136, 138 and 343 support the trust preference rationale.
